idea-plugin.name: CollectionSync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep your Postman and Insomnia collections in sync with your code. CollectionSync — Endpoint Coverage Tracker compares the REST endpoints declared in your Java project (OpenAPI 3.x documents, Spring MVC and JAX-RS/Quarkus controllers) against the requests of your existing Postman (v2.1) and Insomnia (v4) collections. The "Endpoint Coverage" tool window shows, endpoint by endpoint, which ones are covered, uncovered, orphaned or excluded, lets you navigate to the handler method, exclude noisy endpoints from the calculation and export the full report as Markdown or CSV.

Main Features

  • Endpoint Discovery: Scans Spring (@RestController, @RequestMapping...) and JAX-RS/Quarkus (@Path, @GET...) controllers, or a local OpenAPI 3.x document, to build the list of REST endpoints in your project.
  • Collection Import: Parses Postman v2.1 or Insomnia v4 collections (JSON and YAML), tolerating broken files without aborting the report.
  • Coverage Tracking: Classifies every endpoint as COVERED, UNCOVERED or ORPHAN, with structural path matching (variables match by position, strict mode keeps {@code /users/{id}} apart from {@code /users/me}).
  • Exclusions: Right-click any endpoint to exclude it from the calculation (e.g. {@code /actuator/{name}}); excluded rows stay visible so the exclusion can be undone with one click.
  • Navigation: Double-click a row to jump to the controller method, or to the configured OpenAPI document.
  • Export: Export the complete report (including excluded rows) as Markdown or CSV.
